note: Unbaked. Dialogue lines in scene order (Sol, lobby, landing, hatch, six shelf smashes, locks, race, vault, aftermath), then the two girls' landing NPC lines. The Archivist and Vance have no voices yet (new cast entries needed before baking; Vance is also owed from chapter 16). Nara never speaks, so her narration lines are left out. Smash lines are Tom narrating. No battle lines were added (no kind route).

lines.speaker: Sol
lines.text: Downtown. The tallest thing on the boulevard that wasn’t there on Monday. Sixty floors of glass, and every clock in it says 4:59.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: That’s the building. That’s where he is.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: We’re coming. All of us. I already told Rose. She’s packing.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: I packed a pretzel. And a second pretzel, for Deedee.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Girls. It is sixty floors. It is going to be hard and strange and not fair.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: We know. That’s why we’re coming.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Okay. Here’s how we do it. Two teams of three. Grace, Rose and me take the stairs. Amy, TNB and Nara work the Archive on thirty.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: Divide and conquer. I like it. I also like not being on the stairs.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: And I get to hit something. Good.

lines.speaker: Sol
lines.text: I’ll keep the meter off and the engine on. Go get your folks, Tommy.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The tower goes up past the top of the screen. The doors at the bottom are glass, and they are glowing like a lit window at dinnertime.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: It’s so tall. Tata, it’s TALLER than the Starlite.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The lobby is all glass and no people. Every clock says 4:59. The second hands are shaking in place, like they are trying very hard.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: It’s so clean. Nobody lives here. Nobody even touched the floor.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: There’s a plant. It looks scared.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Floor directory says the stairs are on the east side. Twenty-eight flights.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Twenty-eight? That’s a leg day AND an arm day.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The lifts are locked. We take the stairs to thirty. Amy, TNB and Nara meet us up there.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Landing thirty. A huge glass door with a gold lock the size of a dinner plate. The counter over it says LOCKS ENGAGED 6 OF 6.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Six locks. Six of something. I don’t like that.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Tom, this is Amy. We’re in the service ducts. I can hear glass. A lot of glass. There’s a little hatch on your landing, it should open on the Archive.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Found it. Staff only. Somebody wrote HE IS OBVIOUSLY STAFF under it.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: That’s TNB’s handwriting. Go through. Girls hold the landing.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Holding the landing! Holding it! Holding!

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The Archive. A long hall of glass shelves, and on every shelf a whole tiny town under a dome, each one paused on its happiest afternoon.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Tom. Look at the plaque. Look at the little man with the pierogi.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: That’s a very good diorama. I hate it. It’s very well made.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Six towns. Six shelves. The lock counter on the stairs says six. I do not think that is a coincidence.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Smash them. Gently, I mean. Free the towns.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Gently is not a word I use.

lines.speaker: Archivist
lines.text: Attention. A collection has been disturbed. Six exhibits are no longer on file.

lines.speaker: Archivist
lines.text: This is unfortunate. This is not a problem. The Archivist is not unkind. The Archivist is only thorough.

lines.speaker: Archivist
lines.text: Floors 2 to 30 are now unlocked for your convenience. The express lift has been withdrawn. Please use the stairs. All of them. The Archivist will be waiting at the top.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Withdrawn. The lift has been WITHDRAWN. Tom. Did he just challenge me to a stair race?

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I don’t think he knows what he just did.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The seal door swings open on its own. The stairwell goes on. Twenty-nine more floors, straight up, in a glass tube.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: You and me. Landing to landing. Loser buys dinner.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Amy, we have a deadline. We have a tower. We have two grandparents made of stone.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Which is why I am going to win this.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: I am calling it. On my mark. Mark!

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: I’m the finish line!

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: I am not running. I am carrying the thermos. Somebody has to.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Floor fifty-nine. We hit the vault door at exactly the same time. Amy’s forehead and mine, a quarter inch apart.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: That was MINE.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: It was a tie.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Tie means nobody won. Tie means I lost. Rematch. Later. After.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: After.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The Vault. One plinth, one snow globe, and a view of Los Angeles at 4:59 PM, golden and perfect and completely still.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Tata. It’s the Square. It’s in there. That’s Deedee. That’s BOPPY.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: They’re so small. They’re okay. They’re holding hands.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Stay behind me. All of you.

lines.speaker: Archivist
lines.text: Thank you for the six exhibits. The collection is, for the first time, incomplete. I find that I do not like it.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: You’re the Archivist.

lines.speaker: Archivist
lines.text: I am what Mr. Vance keeps when he wants a thing never to change. I file. I label. I hold. It is all I was made to do. It is a very good job.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: You froze the pierogi man for thirty years.

lines.speaker: Archivist
lines.text: Thirty-one. He was very happy. I made sure of it.

lines.speaker: TNB
lines.text: That is the single saddest thing I have ever heard a lens say.

lines.speaker: Archivist
lines.text: Please hold still. This will not hurt. Nothing will, ever again.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Up. Everyone up. We have a lens to break. Breathe. Then we go again.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The amber lens cracks across the middle. The cold one goes dark. For one second, the whole building holds its breath.

lines.speaker: Archivist
lines.text: I was only... keeping them safe.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: I know. They were never yours to keep.

lines.speaker: Archivist
lines.text: What does one do... with a day that is allowed to end?

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: You eat dinner. Then you go to sleep. Then it’s morning.

lines.speaker: Archivist
lines.text: That sounds... sufficient.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Tata. The globe.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The snow globe on the plinth lifts an inch off the glass. The gold cable above it goes tight. It is going up.

lines.speaker: Vance
lines.text: Thank you for the tour, Tom. Thank you for the Archive. It was very nearly complete.

lines.speaker: Vance
lines.text: Floor sixty is for family. Come up when you are ready. I have kept your parents very warm.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.text: Mom. Dad. We are coming. We’re coming.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Everybody breathe. We rest. Then we go to the top.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: A gold lift door stands open at the north wall. No call button. A brass plate: FLOOR 60. BY INVITATION.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Amy picks up the nearest chair like a javelin. “Eat the pierogi, little man.”

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The tiny man finishes his bite. In 1993, in Dunmore, Pennsylvania, 2:15 PM comes at last.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: TNB taps the dome once, lightly, with a pottery tool. “Structurally, this was never going to hold.”

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The firework goes off. Somewhere in Tallulah Falls a crowd on blankets says oooooh, nine years late.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Nara headbutts the shelf. There is a long pause. Then the glass sings and comes down in a bright rain.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The ball comes down in left field. The tiny dad catches it. Cedar Hollow loses in the bottom of the ninth and has never been happier.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: “This is for the lady with the suitcase.” Amy swings. The dome goes.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The tiny woman reaches the ferry. The gangway comes up behind her, and the ferry leaves, and she waves, and she is crying, and it is fine.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: “I have never broken a pie case in my life.” TNB breaks it, apologetically, with his whole arm.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The judge puts down the fork. The baker in the front row screams. It is a very good pie.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Nara and Amy hit the last dome together, from both sides. It comes apart like an ice shelf.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: The two tiny people finish the kiss. The flower girl sticks her tongue out one more time, on principle.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: Team Stairs is holding the landing. That is a very important job. I decided that.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: I can hear the shelves smashing through the wall. Mommy sounds really happy.

lines.speaker: Grace
lines.text: If anything comes up the stairs, it has to get past me. And then past Rose. She is worse.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: I’m guarding the hatch. Nobody comes in. Nobody goes out. Except Tata. And snacks.

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: Is the wall making that noise, or is it Nara?

lines.speaker: Rose
lines.text: I’m going to name every shelf. Shelf one is Gerald.
